Description: Share of predicted failures caught with enough remaining life to order and fit the part. The only prediction quality measure that changes a decision.
Share of active airframes not grounded for maintenance at the reporting date.
Fitted components inside their interval measured in FLIGHT hours. What the maintenance system enforces today, reported because the programme reports it.
Flight-critical components past their stress interval and still fitted.
Of components the model flags, the share that genuinely fail within the horizon. Low precision means crews stop believing the alerts.
Of components that genuinely fail, the share the model flagged. Recall alone is not enough -- see ActionableLeadTimePct.
Fitted components inside their interval measured in STRESS hours. The real compliance figure; 100% is the only passing value on flight-critical parts.
Unscheduled maintenance events as a share of all events. A fleet above this is being maintained by its failures.
